findings.text: follow-on: the re-arm seeding of the drawn groups from stored history is reached by no test - none drives _follow_watch_lines, and the reviewed manifest's own negative_control_note records that dropping the history seeding left 5 of 6 tests green (1 failed, 5 passed), so a regression in this wiring would ship unseen.

follow-on: the printed-rows assertion is made on a path built from groups, the value seed_lift_groups returned two lines above, and PaneRowPath holds any group handed to it, so this line cannot detect a seed_lift_groups regression - only the independent assert groups == {GROUP} at line 153 can.

follow-on: the 6-passed result for the deliverable test file is claimed but unlogged - test_logs names only the two arms and the negative control, whose new-file run is red by design, so the record cannot itself show the measure green.

item_verdicts.diff: read against base 38cba50acc33; the single commit 628006ff6 touches the four write paths plus the evidence fragment, threading lift_groups through ticker.py, follow_checkpoint.py and crew_follow_commands.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks a new test to drive the reload (no pane row), a re-arm from stored history, a first attach and the grant/end cases plus a base and head gate over the importing files; tests/test_a_standing_lift_survives_a_follower_reload.py carries all six cases and I re-ran that file at the reviewed head for 6 passed, with both arms 127 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to carry a pane's memory of the drawn lift groups across the follower's own in-place reload and re-arm; reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1829 reseeds the row path from the carried checkpoint and :1895 restores the groups from the stored history, both before the first row is fed.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the new file 6 passed, the twelve ticker-importing files at 127 passed head and base with zero added failures, and names its three logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths - reckon/crew/ticker.py, reckon/crew/follow_checkpoint.py, reckon/crew_follow_commands.py, the new test file and the evidence fragment; every path the diff touches is inside them and only the declared figures directory is unused.

justifications.durability: the reload arm is guarded (the declared negative control turns tests/test_a_standing_lift_survives_a_follower_reload.py::test_a_reload_holding_the_drawn_groups_draws_no_row_for_the_baseline red, 1 failed EXIT=1), but no test fails if the re-arm wiring at reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1895 regresses.
justifications.evidence: both arms at reckon/crew/runs/gate-base.log and gate-head-confirm.log ran to their 127 passed summary lines with zero added failures, but the measure file's own green run has no log and the head arm's recorded command names a bare python rather than the interpreter the done_when names.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/follow_checkpoint.py:313 seed_lift_groups and reckon/crew/ticker.py:1161 lift_groups follow the surrounding module idioms and name the mechanism with no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1829 passes the carried groups into path.reseed and :1895 rebuilds them from history, so both carriers the goal names reach the row policy before its first feed.
justifications.reuse: seed_lift_groups at reckon/crew/follow_checkpoint.py:313 extends the seeding idiom of seed_states beside it, and the search over reckon/crew found no other owner of a group-keyed lift memory.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the commit 628006ff6 diff is one of the declared write paths in the manifest, with no file outside them modified.
